title: A refused action writes no row
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • You and a second user, {User-B}, are both signed in with the "Admin" role, in two separate browsers.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S12-14 Second Admin.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date, held by no customer, vendor or invoice.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S12-14 Net 14.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page is open in both browsers.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In your browser, click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Delete Credit Term".
  3. In {User-B}'s browser, click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  4. In {User-B}'s browser, click "Make Default for New Customers".
  5. In {User-B}'s browser, click "Make Default".
  6. In your browser, click the red "Delete Credit Term" button.
  7. Click "Cancel".
  8. Click the "⋯" page menu beside "New Credit Term".
  9. Click "Audit Log".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: the confirmation opens.
  • Step 3: {User-B}'s menu opens.
  • Step 4: the confirmation opens.
  • Step 5: {User-B} sees "{Term-A} is now the default".
  • Step 6: the alert "This is your default for new customers. Pick another default first." shows.
  • Step 7: the confirmation closes.
  • Step 8: the menu opens.
  • Step 9: the newest row is {User-B}'s "Default changed"; there is no "Credit term deleted" row.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11681 (Story 12, Credit Terms audit log)

  • S12-R7: “A row is written only when a change is saved. A refused or canceled action (the error handling of Stories 2, 3 and 4, or Cancel) writes nothing, and neither does an action that changes nothing (for example making the current default the default again).”
